uncertainties: Main article Table 2 could not be read (paywalled); classification rests on supplementary Tables B and G (batch2_class_decisions.md item 4). The supplement was re-opened in a public browser on 2026-10-10 and all six target values confirmed (outputs/supplement_reverification_browser.md); the browser passed a Cloudflare 'verify you are human' check, no sign-in.

The fixest version choice (0.12.1) was made after seeing the 0.14.2 result (N 586, IID SE). It is a package-version environment fix allowed by the runbook, and PREREG.md section 2 already expected the default vcov to cluster by unique_id, which is the pre-0.13 behaviour. With current CRAN fixest 0.14.2 every coefficient is identical but T4 would be 586 vs 600 (not exact), so the class computed on current CRAN alone would not be A.

A convergence warning ('Model failed to converge with max|grad| = 0.00231195') is printed during the run; none of the saved lmer models carry a convergence message (outputs/convergence_check_fixest0142.txt), so it comes from a refit inside bootMer or the placebo loop (figures only).
The authors' code pins no versions and gives no sessionInfo; the exact versions the author used are unknown.
